job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced AI Engineer with expertise in AIML to join our team at BMW Techworks India Private Limited. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with excellent problem-solving skills.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and deploy AI models using AIML.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Conduct research and stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in AI.


Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to AI applications.


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business requirements and develop tailored AI solutions.




Job Requirements




Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python or C++.


Experience with deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Excellent understanding of computer vision, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning concepts.


Strong mathematical foundations in linear algebra, calculus, and probability theory.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and communicate effectively with stakeholders.


Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.




About Company



BMW Techworks India Private Limited is a leading technology company that specializes in developing innovative AI solutions. We are committed to staying at the forefront of technological advancements and applying them to drive business growth.
